name: harness-template-library-dev
postStartCommand: apk add make curl; curl -sSLo ./terraform-docs.tar.gz https://terraform-docs.io/dl/v0.19.0/terraform-docs-v0.19.0-$(uname)-amd64.tar.gz && tar -C /tmp -xzf terraform-docs.tar.gz && chmod +x /tmp/terraform-docs && mv /tmp/terraform-docs /usr/local/bin/ && rm terraform-docs.tar.gz
